postHocSweep.note: Not in SPEC.md. Added in review round 1 (finding R1-1), after the SPEC tables were published, because the dashboard serves every horizon, not only 1/7/30/90 days. Rows are the Kalshi dashboard row as published (recomputed from the panel and checked against dist/data/kalshi/ to 6 decimals) and the same row without its post-election prices: qualifying prices of election-set contracts traded at or after the first polls closed. Descriptive; no interval.
